passive.name: Long Night
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **36/42/48/54/60%**. Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Skill and Ultimate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. After the wearer uses Skill or Ultimate, gains "Somnus Corpus." Upon triggering a Follow-Up ATK, consumes "Somnus Corpus," and increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK by **48/56/64/72/80%**.

passive.name: Meteor Swarm
passive.text: For every enemy on the field, increases the wearer's ATK by **9/10.5/12/13.5/15%**, up to 5 stacks. When an enemy is inflicted with Weakness Break, the DMG dealt by the wearer increases by **30/35/40/45/50%** for 1 turn.

passive.name: Each Now Has a Role to Play
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **24/30/36/42/48%** for **3** turn(s).

passive.name: Boundless Thought
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **8/9/10/11/12%**. After using an attack, for each enemy target hit, additionally increases ATK by **4/5/6/7/8%**. This effect can stack up to 5 times and last until the next attack. If there are **3** or more enemy targets hit, this unit's SPD increases by **8/10/12/14/16%**, lasting for **1** turn(s).

passive.name: A Storm Is Coming
passive.text: After entering battle, increases the wearer's DMG based on their Max Energy. Each point of Energy increases DMG by **0.2/0.25/0.3/0.35/0.4%**. A max of **160** Energy will be taken into account for this.

passive.name: Get Ready
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DMG by **12/15/18/21/24%**. For every enemy defeated by the wearer, the wearer's ATK increases by **4/5/6/7/8%**, stacking up to **3** time(s).

passive.name: The Maiden in the Painting
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer's Follow-Up ATKs by **24/30/36/42/48%**. If the current HP percentage of the enemy target is below or equal to **50%**, increases DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATKs by an extra **24/30/36/42/48%**.

substatLine: SPD (breakpoint) = CRIT RATE = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: What Are You Looking At?
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Herta's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: One-Time Offer
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Herta's ATK to all enemies. If the enemy's HP percentage is **50%** or higher, DMG dealt to this target increases by **20%**.

entries.name: It's Magic, I Added Some Magic
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **200%** of Herta's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: Fine, I'll Do It Myself
entries.text: When an ally target's attack causes an enemy target's HP percentage to fall to **50%** or lower, Herta will launch a Follow-Up ATK, dealing Ice DMG equal to **40%** of Herta's ATK to all enemies.

entries.name: It Can Still Be Optimized
entries.text: After using her Technique, Herta's ATK increases by **40%** for **3** turn(s) at the beginning of the next battle.

entries.name: Efficiency
entries.text: When Skill is used, the DMG Boost effect on target enemies increases by an extra **25%**.

entries.name: Puppet
entries.text: Increases the chance to resist Crowd Control debuffs by **35%**.

entries.name: Icing
entries.text: When Ultimate is used, deals **20%** more DMG to Frozen enemies.

entries.name: Kick You When You're Down
entries.text: When using Basic ATK, if the designated enemy's HP percentage is at 50% or less, additionally deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 40% of Herta's ATK.

entries.name: Keep the Ball Rolling
entries.text: Every time Talent is triggered, this character's CRIT Rate increases by 3%. This effect can stack up to 5 time(s).

entries.name: That's the Kind of Girl I Am
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Hit Where It Hurts
entries.text: When Talent is triggered, DMG increases by 10%.

entries.name: Cuss Big or Cuss Nothing
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: No One Can Betray Me
entries.text: After using Ultimate, this character's ATK increases by 25% for 1 turn(s).
